limitations: This is an isolated proposed prototype, not a production rule API or approval.
Only two connectivity settings and two deterministic complete episodes were retained.
The bounded constructor intentionally makes every pair distinguish the settings; broader natural wall fields were not sampled.
The alternate Racket implementation relies on unique seed colors and one seed per component, both explicit prototype-domain constraints.
Finite Racket execution and rival checks do not establish universal induction or training eligibility.

connectivity.input_constraints: each seed belongs to a different non-wall component under both settings; every pair includes a seedless satellite touching one seeded component only at a corner, so four and eight connectivity produce different outputs; another seed and an isolated unseeded component preserve the original object roles
connectivity.invariant_reasoning: identify non-gray seeds; remove each seed marker in row-major order; propagate its color through connected zero cells; preserve gray walls and every component without a seed

eight.text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((colored
         (for*/list ((r (range 0 (rows g)))
                     (c (range 0 (cols g)))
                     #:when
                     (let ((v (at g r c)))
                       (and (!= v 0) (!= v 5))))
           (list r c (at g r c)))))
    (letrec ((flood-8
              (lambda (grid sr sc clr)
                (let grow ((current (set-cell grid sr sc clr)))
                  (let ((next
                         (map-grid
                          current
                          (lambda (r c v)
                            (if (and (= v 0)
                                     (member clr (neighbors-8 current r c -1)))
                                clr
                                v)))))
                    (if (equal? next current)
                        current
                        (grow next)))))))
      (let loop ((grid g) (seeds colored))
        (cond
          ((null? seeds) grid)
          (else
           (let* ((seed (car seeds))
                  (sr (first seed))
                  (sc (second seed))
                  (clr (third seed))
                  (g2 (set-cell grid sr sc 0))
                  (g3 (flood-8 g2 sr sc clr)))
             (loop g3 (cdr seeds))))))))))

             (let loop

                  (cond

                                 (sr (first seed))

                                 (g2 (set-cell grid sr sc 0))
                                 (g3 (flood-fill g2 sr sc clr)))
                            (loop g3 (cdr seeds))))))))))
